# A02-S75: Historical persona

Extract from the operator’s source text. Transport metadata, signatures and marked context omitted.

[…]

I’ve actually lived in the same house as Struensee ;-) But I’m a bit curious about what the festival organizers specifically imagine. Struensee was a doctor and doesn’t have any surviving writings, so I can’t quite imagine how they want to activate his voice. What sources do they imagine / what should the model be trained on? Furthermore, the man was effectively dictator of Denmark, so one might question whether he is truly synonymous with enlightenment. But I guess I’ll have to hear from them!
